answer: Require each identity to earn one non-transferable work receipt before it can trade: it must correctly label a fresh batch of images — jade carvings, marble textures, dune landscapes — checked by two independent auditors. Copied or reused labels trigger enforcement: the identity is banned for 12 epochs and its sponsor slot is revoked. Each batch costs about 22,000 POA in compute and review, so 1,000 fake identities cost 22,000,000 POA of real work, while an honest agent pays 22,000 once. Limitation: the scheme trusts auditor honesty, so colluding auditors could still pass weak work.
